Beyond choosing the right safe, a few essential items and steps will ensure you get the most out of your security setup:
1. Anchoring Hardware: Most standalone safes come equipped with pre-drilled anchor holes. Bolting your safe to a concrete floor or wall studs makes it virtually impossible for thieves to remove.
